subject: Velocis Dedicated GPU pool: provisioning sprint agenda & regional selection
messages:
From: Priya Sinha <priya@velocishealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@velocishealth.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Velocis: Dedicated capacity onboarding — scope & regional selection

Hi Laura / Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Velocis is ready to move forward with a dedicated GPU pool for inference. Before we lock dates, Tom and I want to confirm a few things so our infra team can approve regions and budget:

- Preferred region: US-central but we need a fallback to US-west during peak weekends.
- Expected steady-state concurrency: ~120 active streams, 200 peak (5–6 hour peaks).
- Burst requirement: ability to burst +50% for sustained 2-hour windows.
- Retention/audit: we need a 90-day request log for compliance.

Can you share a short agenda for the provisioning sprint and an outline of what your Dedicated team needs from our side (netops contact, firewall rules, any procurement steps)? I attached our internal capacity planning worksheet for context.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Sinha
VP Platforms, Velocis Health
priya@velocishealth.com

Subject: Re: Velocis: Dedicated capacity onboarding — scope & regional selection

Hi Priya — great to hear Velocis is ready to proceed. Looping in Sean (ops) and Monica (CS) + Ben (eng) so we can align sprint owners.

Proposed provisioning sprint agenda (30–45 min kickoff + 2 week execution sprint):
1) Kickoff: confirm regions, security contacts, and access (30–45 min)
2) Netops & networking prep (day 1–3): firewall rules, peering, IP allowlist
3) Pool provisioning (day 3–6): GPU type selection, quantization profile recommendation
4) Autoscale & burst policy config (day 6–10): thresholds, cooldowns, burst pools
5) Validation & smoke tests (day 11–12): latency/throughput targets
6) Go/no-go & runbook handoff (day 13–14)

What we need from Velocis to start: netops contact + sample traffic traces (1–2 days), preferred GPU family (if any), and a point on procurement for reserved capacity (if you want a committed burst pool). I attached a short mutual-action checklist (velocis-scope.pdf) — we can iterate it live.

Proposed kickoff slots: Thu 12/10 09:00–09:45 PT or Mon 12/14 10:00–10:45 PT. Which works for your team?

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Velocis: Dedicated capacity onboarding — scope & regional selection

Quick ops notes from my side:
- For 120 steady / 200 peak, recommend starting with 4 x A100-40 pools (capacity can be right-sized after smoke tests).
- Autoscale: set target CPU/GPU util at 65% with a 10-min evaluation window; allow burst pool to spin up additional nodes with a 5-min aggressor policy.
- KV / prefix caching: enable prefix caching for common prompts — reduces token cost and lowers downstream latency spikes during peaks.
- Retention: we can enable a 90-day request log; we'll need an S3 bucket ARN and an IAM role from Velocis.

I'll add a short ops checklist to the Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2VelocisOnboard

-Sean

Thanks Tom — appreciate the quick turnaround. Kicking off Monday 12/14 10:00–10:45 PT. Agenda invite sent.

Quick answers to your procurement questions:
- Burst billing: default is overage billing at the per-token/instance rate; if you want committed burst discounts we can propose a short-term reserved addon — Monica will follow up with pricing options in the kickoff.
- 90-day logs: customer-managed recommended (Velocis retains the S3 bucket); Redwood will write logs to your bucket via an IAM role we request during the Netops prep stage.

Action items before kickoff (owner / due):
- Velocis: provide netops contact + S3 ARN (Tom / by 2026-12-14 08:00 PT)
- Redwood: draft runbook & smoke test plan (Sean / by 2026-12-15)
- Redwood CS: pricing brief for burst commitments (Monica / by kickoff)

Linking HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/VELO-2345 — I'll record the kickoff there and attach the signed MAP after we agree.

See you Monday — Laura
